meta.requirement: Explore Stormterror's Lair (5%+ exploration) to trigger this quest.

customTabs.label: TIP
customTabs.content:
You can click the '''Collapse''' button and the '''Best Route''' → '''Important Only''' button at the top to minimize it.
''Some quests will not have a Best Route choice, because the best choice is subjective or not yet found.''

You can also click the '''Endings''' button at the top to view all possible endings, and clicking an ending will show the options needed to reach that ending.

start.title: Salvage Run
start.text:
''Near a collapsed archway, someone has spread a canvas tarp over a heap of rusted plates. A man in a guild work coat is bent over the wreckage with a chisel and a patience that looks expensive.''

''Every few seconds he pauses, listens to the wind, then goes back to work.''

Rolf: ''without looking up'' If you are here to loot, pick a different pile. This one bites back when you assemble it wrong.

''He taps a dented torso plate. It gives a hollow, unhappy ring.''

Rolf: Ruin Guard. Old model. Still had juice in the core when it fell. Guild wants a dampener before the next one wakes up and walks into Mondstadt.

What_do_you_need.text:
Rolf: ''straightens, wiping grime from his gloves'' Chaos Devices. The little rotating cores inside their joints. ''holds up two fingers'' Twenty of them.

''He gestures toward the broken tower where metal footsteps sometimes echo.''

Rolf: The guards still patrolling this lair drop them when they go down. Hunt enough of them and you will have a pile. Bring the devices here and I can wire a proximity dampener that keeps the big ones sluggish.

choices.label: Twenty devices. I can do that

Twenty_devices__I_can_do_that.text:
Rolf: ''nods once'' Good. Do not bother with cracked ones. Whole cores only.

''He marks a crate by the tarp with chalk.''

Rolf: Drop them in that crate when you have twenty. I will be here sorting plates until the wind changes.

''Somewhere above, something heavy shifts in the ruins. Rolf does not look up. He has heard it before.''

dialogues.speaker: 📌 Objective
dialogues.text: Gather 20 Chaos Devices from Ruin Guards and bring them to Rolf at Stormterror's Lair

continues.label: Do /rpg again and then click on Bring Rolf the Chaos Devices

A_dampener_for_what_.text:
Rolf: Something that scrambles their wake-up signal. ''taps the wreck again'' These machines share a resonance band. One active guard can pull others out of the walls like bad teeth.

''He folds his arms.''

Rolf: Lenora at the guild wants a field dampener before someone reports another Ruin Guard on the road to Springvale. To build it I need twenty Chaos Devices from the ones still walking around up here.

''He nods toward the hunt paths.''

Rolf: Hunt them. Strip the cores. Bring them back.

Bring_Rolf_the_Chaos_Devices.text:
''Rolf is at the tarp, same crate, same chalk mark. He looks over as you approach.''

Rolf: Back with hardware, or back with excuses?

Still_hunting_Ruin_Guards.text: Rolf: ''shrugs'' The guards are not going anywhere. ''returns to his chisel'' Just do not take all week. Lenora has a timeline and I have a crate with your name on it.

dialogues.speaker: 📌 Objective
dialogues.text: Gather 20 Chaos Devices from Ruin Guards and bring them to Rolf at Stormterror's Lair

Twenty_Chaos_Devices__as_requested.text:
''You pour the cores into the crate. Rolf catches one mid-roll and holds it to his ear like a watchmaker.''

Rolf: Clean spin. Good batch.

''He sets to work immediately, wiring devices into a brass frame with quick, sure hands. Within minutes a low hum fills the tarp shelter.''

Rolf: Frame is live. Report is written. ''hands you a waxed folio'' Lenora needs this at the guild counter in Mondstadt. She will tell you where the dampener mounts next.

dialogues.speaker: 📌 Objective
dialogues.text: Deliver Rolf's salvage report to Lenora at the Adventurers' Guild in Mondstadt City

continues.label: Go to Mondstadt City (Mondstadt), do /rpg and click on Deliver Rolf's Report to Lenora

Deliver_Rolf_s_Report_to_Lenora.text:
''Lenora is at the guild counter, halfway through stamping a stack of forms.''

Lenora: Salvage report from Stormterror's Lair? ''takes the folio, reads the first page'' Rolf actually finished on schedule. That is a first.

''She flips to the last sheet and taps a map sketch.''

Lenora: The dampener mounts at the high lookout on Stormbearer Mountains. Ridge path above the main trail, you will see the guild marker post. Bolt it to the post, flip the brass switch, and wait for the green pulse.

Stormbearer_Mountains_lookout__Got_it.text:
Lenora: ''slides a compact brass assembly across the counter'' Rolf wired this to the cores you brought. Do not drop it. The guild billing for replacement parts is unpleasant.

''She stamps the folio closed and adds it to her done pile.''

Lenora: Install it at the lookout, confirm the pulse, and you are finished. Rolf will know the field team did their part when the Ruin Guard patrols slow down.

dialogues.speaker: 📌 Objective
dialogues.text: Install the dampener at the Stormbearer Mountains lookout

continues.label: Go to Stormbearer Mountains (Mondstadt), do /rpg and click on Install the Dampener at the Lookout

Install_the_Dampener_at_the_Lookout.text:
''The lookout post sits on a wind-scoured shelf above the main trail. Guild marker, bolt holes, and a view of the lair ruins far below.''

''You seat the dampener on the post, tighten the brackets, and flip the brass switch. For a heartbeat nothing happens. Then the frame hums, steadies, and a pale green light pulses once, twice.''

''On the third pulse the regulator plate splits down the middle. Sparks spray across the post. The green light stutters, dies, and the brass assembly goes cold in your hands.''

''Wind rakes the ridge hard enough to rattle the bolts you just tightened. Somewhere below, a heavy footstep answers after all.''

That_did_not_hold.text:
''The broken frame still smells of scorched metal. Guild chalk on the post. Ruin Guard dust on the trail below. And a regulator that was never meant for this much crosswind.''

''Rolf's note on the folio margin said as much, if you squint at his handwriting: ridge mount needs circuit backup. He did not write how many.''

''You wrap the dead dampener in cloth and stow it. Rolf at Stormterror's Lair will know what snapped. He will also know what replaces it.''

''Ten Chaos Circuits from the Ruin Guards in the lair. Whole ones. Then back to this post.''

dialogues.speaker: 📌 Objective
dialogues.text: Gather 10 Chaos Circuits from Ruin Guards and bring them to Rolf at Stormterror's Lair

continues.label: Go to Stormterror's Lair (Mondstadt), do /rpg and click on Bring Rolf the Chaos Circuits

Bring_Rolf_the_Chaos_Circuits.text:
''Rolf takes one look at the scorched brass in your pack and exhales through his nose.''

Rolf: Ridge wind. ''shakes his head'' I told Lenora to mount lower. She never listens.

''He clears space on the tarp and holds out a hand.''

Rolf: Circuits. If you have them, I can rebuild the regulator before the next patrol wakes up.

choices.label: Ten Chaos Circuits, as you need
Still stripping them from Ruin Guards

Still_stripping_them_from_Ruin_Guards.text: Rolf: ''nods at the broken frame'' The guards drop circuits less often than devices. Hunt more of them. ''already sorting tools'' I will keep the bench clear.

dialogues.speaker: 📌 Objective
dialogues.text: Gather 10 Chaos Circuits from Ruin Guards and bring them to Rolf at Stormterror's Lair

Ten_Chaos_Circuits__as_you_need_.text:
''Rolf slots the circuits into the frame one by one, testing each contact with a small probe. The hum returns, lower and steadier than before.''

Rolf: Regulator rebuilt. Wind-rated this time. ''wraps the assembly and ties it off'' Take it back to the lookout. Same post. Flip the switch and wait for three green pulses without flinching.

''He taps the brass case.''

Rolf: If it pops again, I am blaming the mountain, not my wiring.

dialogues.speaker: 📌 Objective
dialogues.text: Return to the Stormbearer Mountains lookout and install the repaired dampener

continues.label: Go to Stormbearer Mountains (Mondstadt), do /rpg and click on Install the Repaired Dampener

Install_the_Repaired_Dampener.text:
''Same post. Stronger wind. You bolt the rebuilt dampener down, double-check the brackets, and flip the switch.''

''The frame hums. Green light. Once. Twice. Three times. It holds.''

''Below, the heavy footstep fades without a second answer. The ridge feels quieter, like something tense finally unclenched.''

Salvage_Run__Dampener_Mounted.title: Dampener Mounted
Salvage_Run__Dampener_Mounted.text:
''The dampener settles into a quiet rhythm. The green pulse fades to a soft glow you would miss if you were not looking for it.''

''Wind crosses the ridge. Normal wind. No grinding gears answering from the ruins below.''

''Lenora's stipend is yours to claim when you next pass the guild. Rolf will probably say nothing at all, which is how you know he is pleased. The mountain, for once, says nothing either.''
